feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 1 September 2026 10:31pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 01 September 2026 at 10:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the north and west of Britain, with various fronts affecting the Irish Sea at times over the next few days.


##Wind##

Southwest 3 or 4, backing South or Southeast on Wednesday morning, veering South or Southwest in the afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate at first, falling mostly slight.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain, risk of mist patches for a time on Wednesday, becoming mostly fair later in the day.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in the rain, poor in any mist patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or Southwest 3 or 4, veering West or Southwest overnight into Thursday and increasing mainly 5, possibly occasional 6 in places, then decreasing 4 or 5 on Thursday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, imminently becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair, then outbreaks of rain later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain later.
